# tooling

## Caveat

* [What a green CI run covers](ci-coverage.md) - ci.yml runs fmt, kb-lint, featureless clippy plus hermetic cargo test, and the banked layer; extended-validation code, cfg-gated guards and the SM blob have their own rules.

## Design

* [~/.vibegraph asset resolution and pinned fetch](asset-resolution.md) - PDF sets and UFO models resolve flag → env → ~/.vibegraph → dev fallback; only a pinned PDF set can be fetched, SHA-256-verified before an atomic publish. UFO models are never downloaded.
* [Cargo profiles, target directories and load-bearing feature flags](cargo-configuration.md) - dev profile at opt-level 2 keeps debug assertions; release (fat LTO) and release-debug (thin LTO, debug info) profiles; a shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR breaks worktrees; serde_json float_roundtrip.
* [Logging and the terminal UI](logging-and-tui.md) - tracing events under vibegraph::* targets, the progress contract, plain/TUI/file layers, inline-viewport footer, stdout for results only, and graceful stop on q/Ctrl-C.
* [Network consent policy](network-consent.md) - NetworkPolicy Deny/Ask/Allow from --no-network, $VIBEGRAPH_NO_NETWORK and --yes; refusal outranks consent; no terminal means refusal; HttpFetch is built in one place.
* [Release binaries](release-binaries.md) - release.yml builds static musl Linux (baseline and x86-64-v3) and native macOS binaries on tag push, publishes bare executables with SHA256SUMS, and dispatches acceptance.

## Design Decision

* [Licensing: the interned SM model and banked MadGraph outputs](licensing.md) - vibegraph is MIT OR Apache-2.0; binaries embed MG5's models/sm, so --version prints THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES pinned to the source commit; banked MadGraph outputs owe no MG source notice.
* [The default PDF set is fetched, not embedded](pdf-set-distribution.md) - NNPDF23_lo_as_0130_qed is fetched on first use and SHA-256 pinned, not embedded, on an unchecked premise that no redistribution grant exists; member 0 (211–277 kB) was small enough to embed.

## Procedure

* [Per-address profile attribution on macOS (samply, atos, objdump)](instruction-level-profiling.md) - Map unsymbolicated samply samples to instructions and inlined frames with nm, a dSYM, atos -i and llvm-objdump; why cargo-show-asm cannot stand in for the linked test binary.
* [Custom MadGraph cuts via dummy_cuts](madgraph-custom-cuts.md) - Expressing a cut no run-card parameter can (an m(ττ) or pT(γ) window) by patching SubProcesses/dummy_fct.f, which passcuts calls last and which leaves phase-space generation untouched.
* [Generating and regenerating MadGraph reference runs](madgraph-reference-generation.md) - Adding a run (script + manifest row), regenerating through generate-references and build.sh, the --skip-deps and missing-directory traps, what it costs, and the instrumented MLM replay.
* [Running MadGraph here: the pixi env and the pinned submodule](madgraph-toolchain.md) - The madgraph pixi env supplies the toolchain (packaged 3.5.7, never run as the generator); mg5_pinned.sh runs the pinned 3.7.1 submodule; LHAPDF paths and the C++ runtime link fix.
* [mg_perf_compare: per-point timing against MadGraph MATRIX1](mg-perf-compare.md) - Joins MadGraph MATRIX1 ns/eval (host-labelled mg_timings.json) with criterion eval_m2 benches over manifest rows, reporting one-sided rows; what the ratio does and does not license.
* [Profiling and stage timing](profiling.md) - Profile a gate under samply with scripts/profile.sh (release-debug, extended-validation); per-row duration_s with host.json; time_stages.py for MadGraph's own stages.

## Validation Gate

* [Release acceptance: released binary, cards in, events out](release-acceptance.md) - scripts/acceptance.sh on a published release: refusal without consent, consented pinned PDF fetch, llj integrate, offline generate from cache, check-events; run by acceptance.yml.
